query.en: Design a wide shop banner (shop-banner size) for my handmade jewelry store launching a new collection. Warm sand and clay colours, an elegant serif for the collection name with one word in italic, one short sentence about how it's made, a dark pill 'Shop the collection' button, and on the right an arch-shaped window for my product photo with a small name and price tag. Use my product photo if I give you one; otherwise leave a clearly marked placeholder, and don't invent prices.
